name: subscription_orders_amount_check
definition: CHECK ((((plan_key = 'custom'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['quote_requested'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND (total_amount IS NULL)) OR ((total_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (total_amount > (0)::numeric))))

name: subscription_orders_term_check
definition: CHECK (((term_months = ANY (ARRAY[1, 3, 6, 12])) OR ((term_months = 0) AND (order_kind = 'upgrade'::text) AND (COALESCE(pricing_version, 0) >= 7)))) NOT VALID

name: tenh_manual_payment_reference_format_check
definition: CHECK (((manual_payment_reference IS NULL) OR (manual_payment_reference ~ '^TENH-[A-Z0-9]{8,16}$'::text))) NOT VALID

name: tenh_manual_proof_ai_score_check
definition: CHECK (((manual_proof_ai_score IS NULL) OR ((manual_proof_ai_score >= 0) AND (manual_proof_ai_score <= 3)))) NOT VALID

name: tenh_manual_proof_ai_status_check
definition: CHECK (((manual_proof_ai_status IS NULL) OR (manual_proof_ai_status = ANY (ARRAY['matched'::text, 'partial'::text, 'unreadable'::text, 'failed'::text])))) NOT VALID

name: tenh_subscription_payment_route_check
definition: CHECK (((payment_provider IS DISTINCT FROM 'aba_payway'::text) OR ((payment_method IS NULL) AND (proof_path IS NULL) AND (proof_bucket IS NULL)))) NOT VALID

name: tenh_subscription_payway_provider_check
definition: CHECK (((payment_provider IS NULL) OR (payment_provider = 'aba_payway'::text))) NOT VALID

name: tenh_subscription_v4_configuration_check
definition: CHECK (((COALESCE(pricing_version, 0) < 4) OR (((term_months = ANY (ARRAY[1, 3, 6, 12])) OR ((COALESCE(pricing_version, 0) >= 7) AND (term_months = 0) AND (order_kind = 'upgrade'::text))) AND ((requested_user_limit >= 1) AND (requested_user_limit <= 500)) AND ((COALESCE(requested_branch_limit, 1) >= 1) AND (COALESCE(requested_branch_limit, 1) <= 100)) AND (((plan_key = 'solo'::text) AND (requested_user_limit = 1) AND (COALESCE(requested_branch_limit, 1) = 1)) OR ((plan_key = 'small_team'::text) AND (requested_user_limit = 5) AND (COALESCE(requested_branch_limit, 1) = 1)) OR ((plan_key = 'growth'::text) AND (requested_user_limit = 10) AND (COALESCE(requested_branch_limit, 1) = 1)) OR (plan_key = 'custom'::text))))) NOT VALID

name: tenh_apply_approved_branch_plan
tenh_preserve_trial_time_after_paid_approval
